大气层中浓厚的火山灰让我们无法从轨道上辨识这些喷射源，但近距离研究似乎存在危险。

We have visual confirmation of volatile superheated plasma being launched into the upper atmosphere of [from.GetName].

Thick volcanic ash in the atmosphere is preventing us from identifying the source of these projectiles from orbit. Closer study will likely be dangerous.

sections.zh:
我们目睹了敏感的超热等离子体喷发到[from.GetName]的上层大气中。

大气层中浓厚的火山灰让我们无法从轨道上辨识这些喷射源，但近距离研究似乎存在危险。
sections.en:
We have visual confirmation of volatile superheated plasma being launched into the upper atmosphere of [from.GetName].

Thick volcanic ash in the atmosphere is preventing us from identifying the source of these projectiles from orbit. Closer study will likely be dangerous.

texts.zh:
[Leader.GetName]发现了[from.GetName]上的这些超热等离子喷流的源头。

这颗行星的独特磁场促进了地幔深处电离物质之间的反应，形成了高压等离子体的熔岩室。

行星上不稳定的构造板块坍塌时，这些等离子体就像致命的炮弹一样向上射出，与大气中的气体一起点燃，产生二次爆炸。我们的武器专家热衷于将这些原理应用于自己的等离子武器。
texts.en:
[Leader.GetName] has uncovered the cause of the superheated plasma eruptions on [from.GetName].

The unique magnetic field of the planet facilitates a reaction between ionized materials deep within the planetary mantle, creating volcanic chambers of highly pressurized plasma.

When the unstable tectonic plates of the planet give way, this plasma is explosively propelled upward as a deadly projectile, igniting with gases in the atmosphere to create secondary explosions. Our weapons specialists are keen to apply these principles to our own plasma-based armaments.

texts.zh: 不幸的是，这项高度危险的研究给[Leader.GetName]留下了严重的精神创伤。
texts.en: Unfortunately, the hazardous nature of this research has left [Leader.GetName] with severe traumatization.

texts.zh: 不幸的是，这项高度危险的研究给[Leader.GetName]留下了严重的物理损伤。
texts.en: Unfortunately, the hazardous nature of this research has left [Leader.GetName] with severe physical injuries.

summary.text:
# 轨道等离子体 / Orbital Plasma

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：Shadows of the Shroud（has_shroud_dlc） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/103_anomaly_categories_extreme_frontiers.txt:160; events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:432 (extreme_frontiers.170)

## 如何开始 How it starts

熔岩星球可能生成（6级，权重3，全局一次 max_once；需要 has_shroud_dlc，控制者已有激光科技 tech_lasers_2）。

Can spawn on a molten planet (level 6, weight 3, once per game via max_once; needs has_shroud_dlc and a controller with tech_lasers_2).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 extreme_frontiers.170“等离子火山”：非机械物种的领袖有约15%概率“创伤”、约15%概率“伤残”（随机权重170/15/15）；奖励为 d_physics_4 矿藏，并推进下一个等离子科技（tech_plasma_1…3）或每月物理研究。

Single result extreme_frontiers.170 "Plasma Volcanoes": for a non-machine leader there is about a 15% chance of the traumatized and 15% of the maimed trait (random weights 170/15/15); the reward is a d_physics_4 deposit plus progress on the next plasma tech (tech_plasma_1 to 3) or monthly physics research.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支，无后续章节。

Single outcome; no random branch and no further chapter.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

170 的描述按领袖是否创伤/伤残变化。

170's description varies with whether the leader was traumatized or maimed.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义与结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。生成需要 has_shroud_dlc；本机 dlc 目录中未见对应 DLC，能否生成取决于主机的 DLC。

Checked the anomaly definition and the result event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed. Spawning needs has_shroud_dlc; no matching DLC folder exists in the local dlc directory, so spawning depends on the host's DLC.
